=== BASH AND TOOL NOTES, RE-CONFIRMED AT CYCLE 123 ===
Bash refuses paths outside /home/runner/work/SPIRAL/SPIRAL (INCLUDING /tmp); refuses 'python3 script.py' AND 'python3 -c' (SO YOU CANNOT RUN scripts/validate_state.py -- hand-check the gates with jq, and SAY SO rather than implying a validator run); refuses 'cp'; refuses jq's '--arg'/'--rawfile'/'--slurpfile', 'sed -i', 'for' loops, and ANY CHAINING WITH '&&' OR ';'. ONE command per Bash call. A single leading 'cd <dir>; <cmd>' IS accepted, as are 'rm -f', 'mv', redirection, 'ls', 'wc', 'head -c', 'tail', 'sed -n <range>p', 'grep -n', 'grep -c' and PIPES. For multi-file searching use the Grep TOOL.
[227]: a jq program with an OBJECT CONSTRUCTOR (brace, comma, brace) is USUALLY rejected as shell brace expansion -- build an ARRAY OF LABELLED STRINGS and join it. SQUARE BRACKETS ARE SAFE.
[237] THE TWO-INPUT SPLICE, THE ONLY RELIABLE WAY TO APPEND TO THESE FILES: jq -n 'input as $s | input as $t | $t | <edits>' scratch.json target.json > out.json, then 'mv'. [NEW AT 123] jq SCOPING TRAP IN THE APPEND-ONLY PROOF, WHICH COST A TURN: inside 'map(...)' or a '[...[]|...]' comprehension, '.' [NEW AT 123] FOR A PURE-APPEND EDIT SET the simple proof suffices and all clauses must be true: top-level keys equal, ._schema equal, .scores keys equal, every score integer unchanged, every new rationale 'startswith' its old rationale, every rationale strictly longer, and every evidence array's new prefix equal to the old array.
